title: Filtered colimits of commutative rings, elementwise
statement: Let $\mathcal I$ be a small filtered category [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] and $A:\mathcal I\to\mathrm{CRing}$, $i\mapsto A_i$, a functor to the category of commutative rings, with a colimit $(L,(\iota_i)_i)$ in the category of commutative rings. Then: (1) every element of $L$ is $\iota_i(x)$ for some object $i$ and some $x\in A_i$; (2) for $x\in A_i$ and $y\in A_j$ one has $\iota_i(x)=\iota_j(y)$ if and only if there are an object $k$ and morphisms $\phi:i\to k$, $\phi':j\to k$ with $A(\phi)(x)=A(\phi')(y)$.
